subject: Executive workshop — travel exception & cost-share request
messages:
From: Amy Cho <amy.cho@regulushealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@regulushealth.com, tom.rivera@regulushealth.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive workshop — travel exception & cost-share request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for agreeing to host the Regulus senior leadership workshop in SF on Mar 10–11. We have a last-minute change: our VP of Product, Michael Park, has a connecting flight routed through Seoul which makes the economy option a 16+ hour travel day for him. Given the length of travel and his role in the closing session, our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can approve a one-time travel exception for Michael to fly premium economy or short-hop business.

Regulus can cover the standard economy fare; we are requesting Redwood to either: (a) approve the upgrade and absorb up to 50% of the incremental fare, or (b) cover the upgrade and invoice us post-event. We prefer option (a) for speed.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate this exception and what process you need (PO, charge code, signed cost-share)? We can get procurement to sign a cost-share memo if that helps — attaching our initial cost outline.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — booking needs to happen by next Tuesday to avoid a further price spike.

Best,
Amy
Amy Cho
Senior Events Manager
Regulus Health
Attachments: Regulus_Workshop_Cost_Outline.xlsx (referenced)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amy Cho <amy.cho@regulushealth.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive workshop — travel exception & cost-share request

Hi Amy — thanks for the context and the fast heads-up.

On Mon, Feb 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM Amy Cho <amy.cho@regulushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for agreeing to host the Regulus senior leadership workshop in SF on Mar 10–11. ...

I can escalate this immediately. A couple quick asks to speed approval: can you confirm Michael's exact travel dates and the estimated incremental fare amount for premium economy vs business? Also, is he the only attendee who would need an exception? I CC'd our head of sales (Vivek) so he has visibility on the commercial ask.

Our typical policy is to require finance sign-off for any upgrade; if this is time-sensitive we can do a conditional approval with the customer-signed cost-share memo and a charge code to Redwood's event budget, then reconcile post-event.

If you can send Michael's ETA/ETD and the fare estimate today, I'll start the internal approval path.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Regulus travel exception request — need approval and charge code

Vivek / Laura,

Forwarding the request from Regulus (thread below). Summary: VP-level attendee, 16+ hour total trip, Regulus asks Redwood to absorb up to 50% of the upgrade incremental cost to premium economy / short business. Booking deadline is next Tue (2027-02-23).

My recommendation: approve a conditional exception with these constraints —
- Allow premium economy OR short-haul business for any >12hr total travel time.
- Cap Redwood contribution at $1,200 incremental per attendee (covers premium/Y->PE or one-leg Business for regional connections).
- Require customer-signed cost-share doc (DocuSign) and Redwood charge code; finance to confirm charge code and write-off path.

Laura: can you confirm if we have event budget headroom to cover the above cap or whether we need to invoice Regulus for any shortfall? Also please provide the charge code we should put on the DocuSign.

If we approve, I will send Regulus the DocuSign and the travel agency contact for immediate booking.

Thanks,
Olga

> On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM Amy Cho <amy.cho@regulushealth.com> wrote:
> > [original request omitted for thread length]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Regulus travel exception request — need approval and charge code

Olga / Vivek,

I reviewed the event budget and spoke with Finance Ops. We can approve the one-time exception with these constraints:
- Redwood will commit up to $1,000 per attendee as a contribution toward an upgrade. Any incremental beyond that will be invoiced to Regulus under a post-event charge (Regulus PO required).
- Charge code: CAMP-REDW-2027-EVT (use for all bookings).
- Condition: customer signs the cost-share via DocuSign (link needed) and provides a PO or explicit approval email.

I've attached the official Travel Exception Approval Form and flagged it for ops audit. Please ensure procurement executes the DocuSign before bookings. If Regulus needs us to front the full upgrade and seek reimbursement later, we can make an exception but need written commitment and a Regulus PO.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Travel_Exception_Approval_Form.pdf

Amy — good news. Redwood can approve a one-time travel exception for Michael on the conditions below.

On Tue, Feb 16, 2027 at 10:22 AM olga.petrov@redwood.com wrote:
> Summary and recommended constraints ...

Approved items and next steps:
- Approved contribution: Redwood will contribute up to $1,000 toward the incremental upgrade fare for Michael (premium economy or short-hop business).
- Charge code: Please route booking invoices to CAMP-REDW-2027-EVT.
- Required customer actions: Regulus procurement must sign the attached cost-share DocuSign and provide a PO or approval email before Redwood processes payment.
- Booking window: Book by Tue 2027-02-23 to lock fares; if you need Redwood to front payment we will require a signed commitment + PO (per Laura).

Action items for Regulus: please sign the DocuSign I will send in a separate email (link below), and share Michael's travel times and the fare quote by EOD Monday so we can confirm the amount to hold. Once we have the signed doc and fare, our travel agency partner (Aviatrix Travel, contact: ops@aviatrixtravel.com) will complete the booking.

I am attaching the cost-share draft (minor edits accepted) and booking instructions. Reach out to me directly if you want to discuss the cap.

Thanks and see you in March,
Olga Petrov

Redwood Inference
